fullDescription: Mediterranean editorial style guide featuring a warm, paper-like aesthetic with terracotta accents. Optimized for upscale SaaS dashboards, real estate platforms, or boutique digital experiences. Key characteristics include high-contrast serif/sans typography pairing, terracotta (#C2410C) primary accents, hairline borders (#E7E0D8), and soft organic shadows. The layout utilizes a bento-style stat grid and editorial project cards with tinted thumbnails in olive, sand, and clay tones. Suitable for industries requiring a sophisticated, artisanal, or localized premium feel.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, editorial mobile dashboard design termed 'Mediterranean Editorial'. It uses a cream paper background, dark ink typography, terracotta accents, and a blend of refined serif display fonts with clean functional sans-serif for data.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-end editorial UI design using the following specifications: **Color Palette**: Backgrounds: '#FAF7F2' (Cream Paper); Primary Text: '#292524' (Warm Ink); Secondary Text: '#78716C'; Primary Accent: '#C2410C' (Terracotta); Secondary Accent: '#9A3412' (Deep Terracotta); Borders: '#E7E0D8' (Hairline); Success: '#15803D'. **Typography**: Headings: 'Fraunces' (Serif, Semi-bold, -0.01em spacing); Body & UI: 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Sans-serif); Numerical Data: Tabular figures for alignment. **Elevations**: Avoid heavy shadows; use 'shadow-paper' (0 1px 3px 0 rgba(41, 37, 36, 0.05)). **Components**: Use 14px corner radii for cards and buttons. Icons: Lucide style, 1.5px stroke weight. **Mood**: Warm, architectural, professional, and tactile.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Design a sticky header, 60px height, with a '#FAF7F2' background and a 1px '#E7E0D8' bottom border. Left side: Logo icon in a terracotta square (#C2410C, 8px radius) next to a brand title in 18px Fraunces. Right side: A row of 36x36px utility buttons (Search, Language, Notifications) and a circular user profile avatar in terracotta.

### KPI Grid
Implement a 3-column grid for statistics. Each cell is a white card with a 14px radius, 1px '#E7E0D8' border, and soft paper shadow. Content: 36x36px soft-tinted icon container (e.g., 10% opacity terracotta), followed by a 24px semi-bold tabular-number, and a 9px uppercase tracking-wide label.

### Action Row
A horizontal layout containing: 1) A primary 'New' button in terracotta (#C2410C) spanning roughly 50% width. 2) A secondary 'Compare' button with a white background and '#292524' text. 3) A square 44x44px filter button. All elements must have a 14px corner radius.

### Editorial Content Cards
Horizontal layout cards. Left: 128x128px thumbnail area with tinted backgrounds (Olive #E9E9D8, Clay #F5E6D3, or Sand #F3EFE7) featuring a large, low-opacity icon and a bottom-aligned label tag. Right: Content area with a 16px Fraunces title, a secondary info row (location, status badges), and a 2x2 grid of specific data points (e.g., area, price, net profit) separated from the header by a fine line (#F5F2EE). Bottom-right: A profitability trend indicator using green text and a 'trending-up' icon.

### Bottom Navigation Bar
Fixed bottom bar with '#FAF7F2' surface and 1px top border. Include a 34px safe area padding. Navigation items consist of a 32x32px icon container and 10px label. The active state is highlighted with a background pill (#C2410C at 10% opacity) and the icon/label changing to primary terracotta (#C2410C).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Tinted Thumbnail Container — A square media placeholder that uses organic earth-tone backgrounds to categorize content types.
Component: 128x128px square. Background: '#E9E9D8' (Olive). Center element: 30% opacity large Lucide icon. Bottom-edge element: A small, high-contrast rectangular tag with 9px bold uppercase text for content categorization (e.g., 'Residential', 'Commercial').

### Terracotta Status Badge — Small, impactful badges for status or achievements.
Rectangle with 6px rounded corners. Background: '#C2410C'. Text: White, 10px semi-bold. Padding: 2px horizontal, 6px vertical. Include a leading small icon (e.g., trophy or star).

## Notas Especiais
MUST use tabular-nums for all currency and measurements to ensure vertical alignment. MUST maintain a 1px border weight ('hairline') to preserve the editorial feel. MUST NOT use vibrant gradients or high-blur neon shadows. MUST pair the serif display font only with titles, never with functional UI labels or buttons.

style.description: The style essence is 'Tactile Minimalist' or 'Modern Editorial'. It mimics physical paper textures through specific color choices (#FAF7F2 background) and ultra-thin borders. Typography is a critical anchor, pairing the sophisticated serif 'Fraunces' for brand and headers with 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for utility. Animation is subtle, focusing on color shifts and slight shadow transitions.
